title: Toddler formula, Gerber Good Start, Stage 3

content.title: About
content.content: Toddler formula, Gerber Good Start, Stage 3 is a milk‑based infant formula for children 12 months and older, designed to support growth and development. It provides a balanced blend of proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins, minerals, and pre‑biotics for digestive health.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Formulated for toddlers transitioning from baby foods to more solid meals.
Contains DHA and ARA – essential fatty acids important for brain and eye development.
Gerber Good Start uses a “gentle” formula technology that is easier on a toddler’s stomach.
Enriched with iron, calcium, and vitamin D to support bone health and immunity.
Each 400 g container typically lasts 2–3 weeks with daily feeding.

items.title: Supports growth and development
items.content: A balanced mix of macro‑ and micronutrients promotes normal physical growth, brain development, and visual function.

items.title: Digestive health
items.content: Pre‑biotics (fructooligosaccharides) help maintain a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins A, C, E and zinc contribute to the body’s defense against infections.

items.title: Bone health
items.content: Calcium and vitamin D work together to build strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Energy provision
items.content: Complex carbohydrates and plant oils provide sustained energy release.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: The formula contains cow’s milk; consult a pediatrician if an allergy is suspected.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Added sugars are present; limit intake for children prone to dental caries.

items.title: Not for infants under 12 months
items.content: Designed only for toddlers 12 months and older; younger infants should use age‑appropriate formulas.

items.title: Post‑opening storage
items.content: Quality can degrade quickly after opening; use within 30 days.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Mix one level scoop (≈30 g) with 180 ml of warm (not hot) water, stir until smooth, and serve immediately.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep in an airtight container and use within a month.
